primary_metadata_sources: Official Qwen model cards/configs; Hugging Face repository blob metadata for exact distribution revisions, LFS SHA256 and byte sizes. Unsloth quantizations are not official Qwen artifacts.
selection_scope: Bounded local feasibility selection, not an exhaustive model leaderboard or strong-reader certification.

candidates.selection_reason: Newer official instruction-capability reports, Q5 quantization and feasible unchanged memory guards. Model-card claims are not local competence evidence.

Native nonthinking instruction checkpoint on existing qwen3 architecture. Greater quantization precision but older checkpoint; fallback only for documented Qwen3.5 technical incompatibility, never a failed competence score.

Only 225057568 bytes AS headroom before runtime/KV/workspaces. Not a feasible candidate under unchanged hard AS guard; no attempt launched.

inference_settings.system_prompt_relation: Exact v13 prose with only unsupported /no_think suffix removed. Same v13 user prompt formatting.
inference_settings.claim_boundary: v13/v14 compare jointly changed model/checkpoint, quantization, template and nonthinking control; not a checkpoint-only causal contrast.

expected_runtime: CPU completion time is not reliably predicted from model-card metadata. Each process has 1050 seconds wall and 3600 seconds CPU guards; each completion request has 900 seconds. No throughput claim before measurement.

technical_evidence.before_selection: Pinned libllama.so exports dense llama_model_qwen35 model/graph symbols; static support evidence only.
technical_evidence.preflight_result: Native load, template render and 151-token tokenize succeeded with zero completion calls; this establishes bounded technical feasibility, not answer quality.
technical_evidence.full_budget_memory_caveat: A short tokenize preflight does not certify 3500-input plus 256-output peak; guards remain active on every request.

prohibited_selection_changes: No candidate/prompt/control tuning based on v14 outputs. Preserve failed downloads/load/completion/control outcomes and record any new amendment explicitly.
quantization_lineage_limit: Upstream revisions identify inspected official metadata. The quantizer advertises base_model lineage, but this audit did not reproduce quantization or establish that each GGUF was derived from the exact inspected upstream revision. Exact executable GGUF bytes are pinned.
